Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 126: September 2011
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #126 shipped to subscribers in August 2011 (bearing the cover date of September 2011 for Issue 126). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #126 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Ace Combat: Assault Horizon (arcade flight combat)
FIFA 12 (sports simulation)
Pro Evolution Soccer 2012 (sports simulation)
Guardian Heroes (Xbox Live Arcade 2D side-scrolling beat 'em up remaster)
Orcs Must Die! (Xbox Live Arcade action tower defense)
Real Steel (Xbox Live Arcade robot fighting game)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring coverage for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, Battlefield 3, and Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
